name: signer
description: AWS Signer is a fully managed code-signing service to help you ensure the trust and integrity of your code.

subcommands.name: add-profile-permission
subcommands.description: Adds cross-account permissions to a signing profile.

subcommands.name: cancel-signing-profile
subcommands.description: Changes the state of an ACTIVE signing profile to CANCELED.

subcommands.name: describe-signing-job
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specific code signing job.

subcommands.name: get-revocation-status
subcommands.description: Retrieves the revocation status of one or more of the signing profile, signing job, and signing certificate.

subcommands.name: get-signing-platform
subcommands.description: Returns information on a specific signing platform.

subcommands.name: get-signing-profile
subcommands.description: Returns information on a specific signing profile.

subcommands.name: list-profile-permissions
subcommands.description: Lists the cross-account permissions associated with a signing profile.

subcommands.name: list-signing-jobs
subcommands.description: Lists all your signing jobs.

subcommands.name: list-signing-platforms
subcommands.description: Lists all signing platforms available in AWS Signer that match the request parameters.

subcommands.name: list-signing-profiles
subcommands.description: Lists all available signing profiles in your AWS account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the tags associated with a signing profile resource.

subcommands.name: put-signing-profile
subcommands.description: Creates a signing profile.

subcommands.name: remove-profile-permission
subcommands.description: Removes cross-account permissions from a signing profile.

subcommands.name: revoke-signature
subcommands.description: Changes the state of a signing job to REVOKED.

subcommands.name: revoke-signing-profile
subcommands.description: Changes the state of a signing profile to REVOKED.

subcommands.name: sign-payload
subcommands.description: Signs a binary payload and returns a signature envelope.

subcommands.name: start-signing-job
subcommands.description: Initiates a signing job to be performed on the code provided.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to a signing profile.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from a signing profile.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: successful-signing-job
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query status returns Succeeded when polling with ``describe-signing-job``.
